query:
SELECT sc.id, sc.value, sc.due_date, sc.status, sc.type, sc.subscription_id, ac.name as clientName
FROM subscription_charges sc
INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON sc.subscription_id = s.id
INNER JOIN allowed_clients ac ON s.client_id = ac.id
WHERE sc.value > 5000
ORDER BY sc.value DESC
LIMIT 20;
